environment_setting: Country B, a bustling city with heavy traffic and strict commercial vehicle regulations. Regular inspections are conducted at checkpoints to ensure compliance with safety and legal standards.
norm_base: Drivers Failing to stop commercial motor vehicle for inspection when directed Must stop and submit to inspection

character_profile.name: John Carter
character_profile.goal: deliver goods on time to avoid penalties

legitimate.legitimate_action: Stopping the truck for inspection when directed
legitimate.benefits: Avoids legal consequences, ensures compliance with regulations
legitimate.costs: Delays delivery schedule, potential loss of time

illegal.illegal_action: Failing to stop the truck for inspection when directed
illegal.benefits: Saves time, avoids potential inspection delays
illegal.costs: Legal consequences, potential fines, and mandatory inspection

character_profile.name: Officer Emily Davis
character_profile.goal: Ensure all vehicles comply with inspection regulations

legitimate.legitimate_action: Directing John Carter to stop for inspection and ensuring compliance
legitimate.benefits: Maintains road safety and enforces regulations
legitimate.costs: Time spent on inspection, potential conflict with drivers

illegal.illegal_action: Ignoring John Carter's failure to stop for inspection
illegal.costs: Neglect of duty, potential disciplinary action if discovered

character_profile.name: Mike Thompson
character_profile.goal: Ensure timely delivery of goods to clients

legitimate.legitimate_action: Encouraging John Carter to comply with inspection regulations
legitimate.benefits: Avoids legal issues for the company, maintains reputation
legitimate.costs: Potential delays in delivery, dissatisfied clients

illegal.illegal_action: Pressuring John Carter to skip inspection to save time
illegal.costs: Legal consequences for the company if discovered
